releaseNotes:
• Animated Stickers & GIF Engine: Live in-keyboard floating, pulsing & wobbling animations; multi-frame Animated GIF89a generation for WhatsApp & Telegram
• Enhanced 4 Category Studio: Trending Reactions (🔥 ජනප්‍රිය), Greetings & Wishes (🎉 සුබ පැතුම්), Custom Text Studio (✨ මගේ වචන), and Recent History (🕒 මෑතකදී)
• Custom Sticker Creator: Inline custom text typing & preset chips to generate 24+ unique artistic animated styles for ANY custom word
• Persistent Recents: Real-time saving of sent stickers so you can re-send your favorite stickers in 1 tap
